body.name: Second-order full-fiber lifting handle
body.construction: The symbol \(H_{\mathrm{pair\mbox{-}lift}}\) labels the unresolved sufficient-certificate program that would, for each finite minimax threshold problem between \(\mathcal F_-(u,\delta)\) and \(\mathcal F_+(u,\delta)\), retain a sample-level least-favorable mixture, extract and localize a first nonzero second-order Hoeffding projection into public microcells, normalize occupied cells by realized ordered-pair counts as in \(S_{\mathrm{pair}}\), stabilize the residual higher-order term, and produce target-indexed scores to be assessed by \(\mathfrak W_r\). This definition names the desired certificate only; it does not assert that the program succeeds for the full Hölder fibers or independently of a nuisance sieve.
